name: Maccoons 2
summary:
Maccoons 2 is a Gorilla Tag inspired VR Multiplayer experience, where you, and up to 9 other players, queue into a lobby, and play an action packed game of... tag?
Maccoons 2 consists of one map, Forest! Branch around, out maneuvering those Volcano Monkeys anyway you can think of! And, please remember, Reject Humanity, Become Monkey.
